QuestInfo.name: Can You Help Edelstein?
QuestInfo.0: The townspeople seem to hate anyone who is a part of the #p1101000# Knights just as much as they hate the Black Wings. But, you still don't know why... Talk to #b#p2152000##k in front of the school. He seems friendly enough to answer your questions...
QuestInfo.1: Apparently, the #p1101000# Knights have broken their promise to this town. You, personally, may not be responsible, but it is your duty as a Cygnus Knight to regain their trust. When you tell him that, #p2152000# says he will have the townspeople open up to you if you find #b#t4000603#s#k for the children.\n\n#i4000603# #t4000603# #b#c4000603# / 40#k
QuestInfo.2: #m310000000# is a town that has been taken over by the Black Wings, and for some reason, they hate the #p1101000# Knights, as well... #p2152000# said that you should know the answer to that question better than anyone, and avoided giving you a straight answer.

0.0: Truth is, we know that the #p1101000# Knights are not an evil organization. But still, the people of this town have a reason to hate the #p1101000# Knights. It's because...they betrayed us when we needed them most...
0.1: It seems you genuinely don't have any idea what I'm talking about. I'm sorry for generalizing and blaming you for something you weren't involved with. Maybe the people here will be able to accept #p1101000# Knights like you. The ones who weren't involved with what happened.
0.2: Still, the townspeople will be suspicious of you just for being a #p1101000# Knight. You should do #bsomething that will earn their trust#k. Think you can do that?

yes.0: Since your will is strong, I'm sure that the townspeople will come to trust you soon. Please do me this one thing. The building you see in the back is the school where the kids in this town study. Some strange recent incidents have caused a shortage of light bulbs there.
yes.1: If you travel to the right of town to reach the #b#m310030310##k, you will find many #r#o2150002#s#k there. Please defeat them and bring back #b40 #t4000603#s#k. For the kids. If you can do that, I will try my best to convince the townspeople to trust you.

no.0: There is not a single person in this town who will trust a #p1101000# Knight without cause. Not a single person in this town will give you a quest. Is that okay with you?

1.0: You've brought all the Light Bulbs. Thank you. I will let the other townspeople know that there are good people like you in the #p1101000# Knights.
1.1: Years have passed since this town was taken over by the Black Wings, and the hearts of the townspeople have hardened more and more. Still, I'm sure they will be able to trust an upstanding person like you.

yes.0: Why do the townspeople hate the #p1101000# Knights? Need I really explain that? The leader of the #p1101000# Knights should be the one to explain... Don't worry, I know that you are not a coward like she is.

item.0: Have you not been able to get the #b40 #t4000603#s#k yet? If you bring the light bulbs that will be used in the schools, I'm sure that the people in town will come to trust you. Please go the right of town to reach the #b#m310030310##k.
